Remark
[Refined Type IIb rescaling] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0260 1. Equations 8.22, 8.23\group dilations-of-infinite-time-singularities

Choosing $(x_i,t_i)$ to nearly maximize \[ \frac{t_i(T_i-t_i)|\Rm (x_i,t_i)|}{\sup _{\mathcal M^n\times [0,T_i]}|t|(T_i-t)|\Rm (x,t)|} \] ensures that both $\alpha _i=t_i|\Rm (x_i,t_i)|$ and $\omega _i=(T_i-t_i)|\Rm (x_i,t_i)|$ tend to $\infty $, and the dilations satisfy a uniform curvature bound on larger and larger time intervals.
